text: My landlord framed the new tax bill and hung it in the hallway, like a diploma he earned off my rent.
name: Tyrone Marsh

text: The spark plugs cost more than the education that taught me to change one, and the man who owns the shop took one look at my red light and saw a cruise.
name: Delia Okafor

text: I wore the same pair of shoes to a funeral and a job interview, and the price on them went up faster than either of those ended.
name: Sam Whitlock
